## Appearance

Ruby Gillis is known for her showy appearance, featuring a brilliant complexion, long golden hair, and a plump figure. Her hair has been worn in a long yellow braid or adorned with red geraniums, and her large, blue eyes are notably bright and lustrous.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. ## Personality

A cheerful and good-tempered individual, this young woman openly enjoys life's simple pleasures, though she is notably prone to fits of hysterics. She is highly coquettish and increasingly preoccupied with romance, young men, and receiving male attention. Her primary ambitions are to attract numerous suitors, begin dating by the age of fifteen, and marry after a brief two-year teaching career.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis grew up in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) with many big sisters and once had her warts magically charmed away by old [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md) from the Creek. During her schooldays, she joined [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) in forming a [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club). She later went on a visit to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) during the autumn and eventually received a marriage proposal from Nelson Atkins. While [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was away at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Ruby maintained correspondence with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learned that Ruby was terminally ill. During a visit, Ruby attempted to keep up a lively facade regarding her social life and future plans, but she later tearfully confessed her fear of dying and her love for her earthly life to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Ruby passed away peacefully in her sleep the following night, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community to mourn her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Quotes

> “Nor I,” said Ruby Gillis, with a shiver. “I don’t mind floating down when there’s two or three of us in the flat and we can sit up. It’s fun then. But to lie down and pretend I was dead—I just couldn’t. I’d die really of fright.”
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)

> "There’s a concert at Carmody and a party at White Sands. Herb Spencer’s going to take me. He’s my latest. Be sure to come up tomorrow. I’m dying for a good talk with you. I want to hear all about your doings at Redmond."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Life P8](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0008)

> "Me! Why, I’m perfectly well. I never felt better in my life. Of course, that congestion last winter pulled me down a little. But just see my color. I don’t look much like an invalid, I’m sure."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Life P57](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0057)

> "Anne, it won’t be long now before I’ll be lying over there. You and Diana and all the rest will be going about, full of life—and I’ll be there—in the old graveyard—dead!"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Summons P7](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0007)

> “I know it—I’ve known it all summer, though I wouldn’t give in. And, oh, Anne”—she reached out and caught Anne’s hand pleadingly, impulsively—“I don’t want to die. I’m afraid to die.”
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Summons P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are schoolmates and long-standing friends who exchange gifts and tokens of appreciation. ### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby and [Jane](../character/jane.md) are old friends who belong to the same core circle of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) companions.
